articles.headline: Kirst's 5 goals lead Waterdogs to PLL championship over Outlaws
articles.description: The Philadelphia Waterdogs, led by league MVP CJ Kirst, claimed the Premier Lacrosse League championship with a 14-4 victory over the Denver Outlaws on a rainy Sunday at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey.
